history.summary: A genuinely strong 2BR investment case: a 1001 sqft unit listed at $1,558 psf is ~11% under the URA median of $1,747.5 in a development sitting 190m from Sengkang MRT/hub. Keppel Land build, 622 units, deep resale liquidity (184 txns) and 7.3% resale-only CAGR. The standout of this batch.
history.rating_rationale: $1,558 psf vs $1,747.5 URA median = clear discount on a generously sized 1001 sqft 2BR (efficient $/unit at $1.56M, in the liquid sub-$1.6M band). 7.3% resale-only appreciation on 184 transactions is high-confidence. 190m to Sengkang MRT interchange + Compass One mall is best-in-class connectivity for the district. Reputable developer (Keppel Land), large 622-unit base for liquidity. Top technical frontier score (911). Only mild caveat: unit is large for a 2BR so per-sqft rent dilutes yield slightly.
red_flags: Large 1001 sqft footprint for a 2BR dilutes psf-rent yield versus a compact unit
OCR/D19 baseline appreciation is lower than RCR; sustained 7.3% partly reflects a strong recent cycle
catalysts: Direct 190m access to Sengkang MRT interchange + Compass One / Sengkang Grand Mall hub
Discount to URA median leaves room for mean-reversion upside
Buangkok/Sengkang continued HDB-upgrader demand keeps deep buyer pool

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Strong tenant pool — directly atop a major NEL interchange and mall, appealing to families and commuters to CBD; large 1001 sqft 2BR commands a rent premium in absolute terms even if psf-yield is moderate.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: 7.3% resale-only CAGR on 184 transactions is reliable and the listing's discount to median supports continued upside; expect mid-single-digit forward appreciation rather than a repeat of the full historical rate.

history.summary: A 1,001 sqft 2BR at The Luxurie (Sengkang, Keppel-built) priced at fair value — ask is essentially in line with recent 2BR comps, so the modest -9.4% age-adjusted signal is not a meaningful bargain.
history.rating_rationale: Verified transactions show The Luxurie 2BR units trading at S$1,610-1,626 psf (732 sqft) and a 969 sqft unit at S$1,610 psf (Sep 2025), so the S$1,558 psf ask on a slightly larger 1,001 sqft unit is roughly fair, not cheap — larger units correctly carry slightly lower PSF. The -9.4% age premium and -1.9% cohort premium (15 txns) describe a fairly-priced unit, not an edge. It is a well-regarded Keppel Land development with good architecture near Buangkok MRT, OCR (favourable region), but there is no dated catalyst and yield is only ~3-3.5%. Under v3.4 priors, a near-fair price plus no decisive physical catalyst lands at Neutral, not the score-827 Buy the algo implies. This is the 2BR (not the over-ranking small high-PSF 1BR that the v3.2 cohort fix targeted), so the score is more credible — but still not a bargain.
red_flags: Ask is at/near recent transacted PSF — the 'cheap' signal is essentially fair value, not a discount
Noise from nearby traffic and aircraft operations noted in resident reviews
catalysts: Keppel Land build, well-regarded architecture, near Buangkok MRT
Mature Sengkang/Compassvale estate with full amenities
